turns.user: Good to know. It's now three working days past the date it was due. At what point does a parcel count as lost? I don't want to wait for weeks and then be told it's gone.

Vacuum it regularly with the brush roll off, and the shedding will slow down within a couple of months. Don't pull any longer tufts that stick up; trim them level with the pile using scissors instead. A rug pad underneath also helps, because it reduces the friction that loosens fibres.
